_comment: The complete set of sling subcommands, captured from `sling --help` on v0.1.2 (2026-08-25). This file exists so a test can prove SKILL.md never routes to a subcommand that does not exist. Update it, and the changelog, when a sling release adds or removes a command.

exit_codes.3: not found, or no stored logs
exit_codes.10: remote outcome failed (doctor unhealthy, or runs show --wait on a non-success run)

global_flags_note: --org and --repo are rejected by `logs` (strict parser, exit 2); every other data command accepts them. Unknown flags are ignored everywhere except `logs`.
